title: Design, Synthesis and Bioactive Evaluation of Topo I/c-MYC Dual Inhibitors to Inhibit Oral Cancer via Regulating the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway.
authors: Zheng, Bin; Wang, Yi-Xiao; Wu, Zi-Yan; Li, Xin-Wei; Qin, Li-Qing; Chen, Nan-Ying; Su, Gui-Fa; Su, Jun-Cheng; Pan, Cheng-Xue
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成Topo I/c-MYC双靶抑制剂并评估其抗口腔癌活性，虽涉及Topo I-DNA复合物分子对接，但核心是药物化学与肿瘤药理学，非TF-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法研究。
abstract: The significantly rising incidence of oral cancer worldwide urgently requires the identification of novel, effective molecular targets to inhibit the progression of malignancy. DNA topoisomerase I (Topo I) is a well-established target for cancer treatment, and many studies have shown that different cancer cell genes could be targeted more selectively with one type of Topo I inhibitor. In this report, a new scaffold pyridothieno[3,2-c]isoquinoline 11,11-dioxide was designed via the combination of the key fragment or bioisoster of Topo I inhibitor azaindenoisoquinolines and G-quadruplex binder quindoline. Thirty-two target derivatives were synthesized, among which compounds 7be, with potent Topo I inhibition, exhibited effective antiproliferative activity against Cal27, one of the oral cancer cell lines highly expressing Topo I protein. Further studies indicated that 7be could also inhibit the activation of PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB pathway and downregulate the level of c-MYC, repress the colony formation and the migration of Cal27 cells and trigger apoptosis and autophagy. Molecular docking indicated that 7be could interact with the complex of Topo I and DNA via a mode similar to the indenoisoquinolines. The results of the Cal27 xenograft model confirmed that 7be exhibited promising anticancer efficacy in vivo, with tumor growth inhibition (TGI) of 64.7% at 20 mg/kg.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内口腔癌发病率的显著上升，迫切需要识别新型、有效的分子靶点以抑制恶性肿瘤的进展。DNA拓扑异构酶I（Topo I）是癌症治疗中公认的靶点，许多研究表明，不同类型的癌细胞基因可通过一种Topo I抑制剂更选择性地靶向。在本报告中，通过结合Topo I抑制剂氮杂茚并异喹啉的关键片段或生物电子等排体与G-四链体结合剂喹啉啉，设计了一种新型骨架吡啶并噻吩并[3,2-c]异喹啉11,11-二氧化物。合成了三十二个目标衍生物，其中化合物7be具有强效的Topo I抑制作用，并对高表达Topo I蛋白的口腔癌细胞系Cal27表现出有效的抗增殖活性。进一步研究表明，7be还能抑制PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB通路的激活，下调c-MYC水平，抑制Cal27细胞的集落形成和迁移，并触发凋亡和自噬。分子对接表明，7be可通过类似于茚并异喹啉的方式与Topo I和DNA复合物相互作用。Cal27异种移植模型的结果证实，7be在体内表现出有前景的抗癌疗效，在20 mg/kg剂量下肿瘤生长抑制率（TGI）为64.7%。
